question:
Simplify the following expression.

(sintheta-2sin³theta)/(2cos³theta-costheta)
solution:
**Calculation:**

(sinθ-2sin³θ)/(2cos³θ-cosθ)

Sinθ(1 - 2sin²θ) / Cosθ(2cos²θ - 1)

⇒ Sinθ × cos2θ / Cosθ cos2θ 

⇒ Sinθ / Cosθ = tanθ

**∴ The correct option is 1**
